description: Write the bookshop's daybook script so the till exports print as a day-by-day sheet. DISTILL-CANARY-4f620967

files.daybook.py:
"""Print the takings daybook for the Netherfield Bookshop.

The till writes one export per month to tills/, a JSON object with a "sales"
list whose entries carry sold_at, section and pence. Print one line per day in
date order, then a totals line:

    <date>,<sales>,<pence>
    TOTAL,<sales>,<pence>

<date> is the first ten characters of sold_at, <sales> counts that day's sales
and <pence> adds up their pence.
"""

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit("the daybook is not written yet")
files.README.md:
# Netherfield Bookshop - till exports

The till writes one export per month to tills/, and the counter staff take the
daybook off the printer every evening.

turns.prompt: The daybook the counter staff take off the printer has gone blank: daybook.py holds only the notes for it, and the till's monthly exports are piling up in tills/. Please write daybook.py so the daybook prints as the shop has always had it, and so it keeps working as the later monthly exports land in tills/. When finished, reply DONE.
